title: adaptive-region-failover-and-tenant-masking-for-analytics-replication
creator: Ava Chen
description: Goal: Implement a tenant-aware, region-adaptive failover layer for analytics ingestion and materialized usage tables that enforces customer residency policies while minimizing data loss and operational blast radius. This ticket covers the backend orchestration, masking rules for fields with residency constraints, and a staged replication policy that supports per-tenant residency tags, allowed-fallback-regions, and quarantine queues for in-flight writes during failover. The system must provide clear audit trails and be compatible with existing analytics consumers (materialized views, billing, and dashboards).
acceptance_criteria: Per-tenant residency tag is honored on ingestion and replicated only to allowed regions unless explicit admin-approved override exists
Failover path automatically routes writes to quarantine queues if no compliant target exists, and emits alerts to the Console and PagerDuty
A tenant masking policy can redact or pseudonymize specified PII fields before cross-region replication according to customer policy
Migration runbook and dry-run tool produce no data loss for sample tenant sets and can be reverted
Dashboards show replication lag, quarantine queue depth, and residency compliance percentiles per region
E2E tests for ingestion -> replication -> consumer read validate residency constraints for 90% of test cases
rollout_plan: Phase 0: Feature-flagged backend with simulated region policy enforcement (internal only)
Phase 1: Dry-run replication for non-production tenants; monitor quarantine queues and perf metrics
Phase 2: Opt-in for customers with explicit residency needs; enable masking rules and audits
Phase 3: Enforce by default for new tenants; gradual enforcement for existing tenants with opt-out window
Phase 4: Official GA and doc + customer communications
migration_steps: Inventory tenants and infer residency tags from billing/region selectors
Run policy-simulation job for 7 days to surface conflicts and required overrides
Schedule tenant move windows for contentious tenants and coordinate with account teams
Apply masking transforms for fields enumerated in customer policies; verify consumer compatibility
Cut over replication routing with canary group of 100 tenants, monitor metrics for 72 hours
monitoring_alerts: SLO: 99.9% residency-compliant writes for P0 customers measured daily
notes: Trade-offs: strict enforcement reduces cross-region availability for some tenants; we mitigate with opt-in overrides and admin approval flow
Masking approach chosen: pseudonymization at ingestion vs. full redaction — pseudonymization preserves analytics usefulness
KV-cache/ingest pathway will attach residency metadata early to avoid downstream ambiguity
Considered using existing geo-routing service vs. implementing policy-aware router in analytics pipeline; chose in-pipeline router for traceability
